instruction: Open View > Master Slides, select the slide number text placeholder, and change the font to Arial using the font dropdown in the formatting toolbar

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires the agent to navigate to master slides view and change the slide number font to Arial. The evaluator verifies the font by parsing the slide master XML and checking for the typeface attribute in the latin element of the text run properties.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly identifies slide number placeholder (ph_type='sldNum') in master slide XML
Font checking logic appropriately searches both a:rPr and a:defRPr elements for latin typeface
Case-insensitive font comparison handles variations in font name casing
Postconfig properly saves file with Ctrl+S before verification
Expected value 'Arial' correctly matches instruction requirement

Minor issue: Metric uses descendant search (.//a:rPr) which could match Arial in nested text runs unrelated to the actual slide number, potentially causing false positives if placeholder contains multiple text runs
However, in typical PowerPoint/Impress files, slide number placeholders have simple structure, making false positives unlikely in practice
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider more precise XPath to target the specific text run containing the slide number field rather than searching all descendants
Could verify the placeholder only has one text run or check the field code to ensure it's the actual slide number
Minor refinement: Check if the font is set at the most specific level (run properties) rather than accepting any nested match
